items.title: NYC’s Shelter Population Speaks Out in Public Art Project
items.summary: Alex Strada’s “Public Address” brings handwritten testimonies from over 400 unhoused New Yorkers and shelter staff to a dozen locations across the Bronx.

items.title: The Titillating Tale of Damien Hirst’s Gay Hole
items.summary: An infectious play by Sleth explores infatuation and fame through an imagined relationship between Hirst and his gay lover, a younger artist whose paintings consist of holes on the ground.

items.title: What “The Book of Genocides” Teaches Us
items.summary: Dana Mashoian Walrath’s work of graphic nonfiction points to historical patterns across 10 genocides, from Germany and Turkey to Gaza.
